question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aware**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The word "**aware**" means having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact. (किसी स्थिति या तथ्य का ज्ञान या बोध होना)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Grammatically, it is an adjective that modifies the subject of the sentence.
